about: Named route cases for tools/walk_sweep.py: a and b in tile coordinates (the atlas's col, row: what Route.Find takes), inst 0 Eastern Kingdoms, 1 Kalimdor. expect (optional): class 'found' | 'partial' | 'none' | 'capped', or 'nofound' (partial or none: there is no walk); max_ratio (route length / straight); steep false (must not climb a face over 50 degrees by more than 2 yd). note: what a good answer looks like.

cases.name: Sun Rock cliff
cases.note: Must NOT climb the cliff: round by the ramp. 5eedf63 fixed it (705 yd -> 268 for 267 straight).

cases.name: Thunder Bluff low -> top
cases.note: Only the lifts reach the mesa top; a route up the cliff face is wrong. 3.1 has no lift link: no way is honest there.

cases.name: Crossroads -> Cenarion Hold
cases.note: Long: Barrens, Great Lift, Thousand Needles, Tanaris or Feralas, Un'Goro, Silithus. Main hits its 60k-node cap.

cases.name: Marshal's Refuge -> Cenarion Hold
cases.note: Un'Goro to Silithus through the western pass. Main: found at 1.96x straight.

cases.name: Kharanos -> Anvilmar
cases.note: Dun Morogh road west, through Coldridge Pass into the valley.

cases.name: Goldshire -> Lakeshire
cases.note: Elwynn east road to Three Corners, Redridge road over the bridge.

cases.name: Goldshire -> Sentinel Hill
cases.note: Elwynn west road over the bridge into Westfall, south to the hill.

cases.name: Kharanos -> Thelsamar
cases.note: Dun Morogh east road and the North Gate Pass tunnel (a hand link) into Loch Modan.

cases.name: Goldshire -> Loch Modan plateau
cases.note: A plateau nobody walks onto: partial (as near as it gets) or no way, never a climb.

cases.name: Freewind Post -> canyon floor
cases.note: Freewind's mesa: the lift down. 3.1: mesa is its own region, no lift link: no way is honest.

cases.name: Darkcloud Pinnacle -> canyon floor
cases.note: Down the pinnacle's switchback path; never straight down the face.

cases.name: Great Lift: Southern Barrens -> Needles floor
cases.note: Through The Great Lift (hand link) down into Thousand Needles.

cases.name: Camp Taurajo -> Freewind floor
cases.note: Southern Barrens road, the Great Lift, east along the canyon.

cases.name: Crossroads -> Malaka'jin (Barrens-Stonetalon)
cases.note: West road out of the Crossroads, up into Stonetalon by the Barrens pass.

cases.name: Sun Rock -> Nijel's Point (Stonetalon-Desolace)
cases.note: South out of Stonetalon by the road into northern Desolace.

cases.name: Shadowprey -> Camp Mojache (Desolace-Feralas)
cases.note: Desolace south road into Feralas, east along the forest road.

cases.name: Astranaar -> Bloodvenom Post (Ashenvale-Felwood)
cases.note: North road out of Ashenvale up into Felwood.

cases.name: Talonbranch Glade -> Everlook (Timbermaw)
cases.note: Felwood to Winterspring only through the Timbermaw Hold tunnel; over the mountain is wrong.

cases.name: Talonbranch Glade -> Nighthaven (Timbermaw)
cases.note: Moonglade too is reached through Timbermaw Hold's tunnel.

cases.name: Gadgetzan -> Marshal's Refuge (Tanaris-Un'Goro)
cases.note: West across Tanaris, down the ramp into the crater, the crater road.

cases.name: Thalanaar -> Camp Mojache (Feralas)
cases.note: Feralas' east road through the forest.

cases.name: Brackenwall -> Theramore (Dustwallow)
cases.note: Marsh roads, over the causeway onto Theramore Isle (or a short swim).

cases.name: Razor Hill -> Crossroads (Durotar-Barrens)
cases.note: Durotar's road west over the river bridge into the Barrens.

cases.name: Orgrimmar -> Razor Hill
cases.note: Out of the city by the south gate, down the road.

cases.name: Bloodhoof -> Camp Taurajo (Mulgore-Barrens)
cases.note: East through Mulgore's gate road into the Barrens.

cases.name: Auberdine -> Astranaar (Darkshore-Ashenvale)
cases.note: Darkshore coast road south into Ashenvale.

cases.name: Menethil -> Refuge Pointe (Thandol Span)
cases.note: Wetlands road north-east, over the Thandol Span (a hand link) into Arathi.

cases.name: Thelsamar -> Menethil (Dun Algaz)
cases.note: North through Dun Algaz's pass into the Wetlands, west to the harbour.

cases.name: Thelsamar -> Kargath (Loch Modan-Badlands)
cases.note: South Gate Pass (a hand link) down into the Badlands, west to Kargath.

cases.name: Kargath -> Thorium Point (Badlands-Searing Gorge)
cases.note: West out of Kargath by the canyon into Searing Gorge, round the cauldron's rim.

cases.name: Morgan's Vigil -> Lakeshire (Burning Steppes-Redridge)
cases.note: Down the Redridge pass south of Morgan's Vigil, round Lake Everstill.

cases.name: Darkshire -> Rebel Camp (Duskwood-Stranglethorn)
cases.note: Duskwood's road west then south into northern Stranglethorn.

cases.name: Grom'gol -> Booty Bay
cases.note: Stranglethorn's road south to the cove.

cases.name: Tarren Mill -> Chillwind Camp (Alterac)
cases.note: Hillsbrad north through the Alterac foothills into Western Plaguelands.

cases.name: Southshore -> Strahnbrad (Hillsbrad-Alterac)
cases.note: North up the Alterac road.

cases.name: The Sepulcher -> Brill (Silverpine-Tirisfal)
cases.note: Silverpine road north, the Tirisfal road east.

cases.name: Stonard -> Nethergarde Keep (Sorrows-Blasted Lands)
cases.note: Out of Stonard, south through the pass into the Blasted Lands; Nethergarde sits on a rise.

cases.name: Stormwind -> Goldshire
cases.note: Out by the Valley of Heroes and the gate bridge, the road south.

cases.name: Goldshire -> Darkshire (Elwynn-Duskwood)
cases.note: Elwynn's road south-east over the bridge into Duskwood.

cases.name: Tarren Mill -> Aerie Peak (Hinterlands)
cases.note: East through the Hinterlands gate, up to the dwarves' peak.

cases.name: Chillwind Camp -> Light's Hope (Plaguelands)
cases.note: East across both Plaguelands along the road.

cases.name: Refuge Pointe -> Hammerfall (Arathi)
cases.note: Across the Arathi highlands.

cases.name: Booty Bay -> Light's Hope (very long)
cases.note: The length of the continent: Stranglethorn, Duskwood, Redridge or Elwynn, Burning Steppes, Badlands or Dun Morogh, Loch Modan, Wetlands, Arathi, Hillsbrad or Hinterlands, the Plaguelands.

cases.name: Feathermoon -> Everlook (very long)
cases.note: Swim off the island, Feralas, Desolace, Stonetalon, Ashenvale, Felwood, Timbermaw, Winterspring.

cases.name: Orgrimmar -> Gadgetzan (long)
cases.note: Barrens south, Great Lift, Thousand Needles east to the Shimmering Flats, Tanaris.

cases.name: Auberdine -> Dolanaar (Teldrassil)
cases.note: Teldrassil is boat only: no way (partial to the shore at most).

cases.name: Crossroads -> GM Island
cases.note: An island no walk or swim joins: no way, answered at once.

cases.name: Revantusk -> offshore island (Hinterlands)
cases.note: An island in the Forbidding Sea that 3.1's regions keep apart from the coast: no way.
